preconditions: Passing actual capture at1257 with complete root closure, fresh raw custody/seal and independent native lifetime disposition.
Actual extraction runs with nativeAuditAuthorized=false and rootExtractionAdmissionApproved=false; generated root-assignment.auditAuthorized and extraction admission.approved must remain false.
Root inspects concrete complete native/public files, selection receipts, query metadata, raw before/after equality and actual custody/lifetime/source/build identities before any promotion.

steps.action: Seal and retain the complete original unapproved extraction directory without mutation.
steps.detail: Record complete filenames, byte counts, SHA-256 and modes. Preserve original bundle/root-assignment.json, original root-extraction-admission.json, original root-extraction-input.json, extraction result, selection receipt and raw-verification receipt. Read-only files plus root policy preserve this baseline; no rerun or in-place approval edit.

steps.action: Copy the entire original bundle to one fresh canonical private external directory outside both checkouts.
steps.detail: Use independent regular-file byte copies, no symlinks or hardlinks. Retain the complete original filename set and byte-identical native/public/source/closed/collector/extraction receipts. Keep promotion documents outside bundle. Authenticate all copied bytes against the retained original before authorizing.

steps.action: Replace only copied bundle/root-assignment.json with the approved native assignment.
steps.detail: Parse its existing exact12-field object. Set auditAuthorized fromfalse totrue after root approval. Preserve every other field and descriptor. Write complete new bytes, set mode0444 and compute its new byte count and SHA-256. Keep the original file unchanged.

steps.action: Inventory every file in the approved copy after that replacement.
steps.detail: Produce sorted complete unique relative path/bytes/sha256/mode rows. Each file is mode0444. All rows except root-assignment.json must match the original inventory. Compute the new native root assignment digest independently; it is the new audit anchor.

steps.action: Issue a fresh rootExtractionAdmission outside the copied bundle.

fieldsToChange.bundlePath: absolute canonical path to approved copied bundle

steps.fieldsToRetain: Original sourcePin1257, matchId, auditorSha2564862672e, closedFreshRawAuthenticated=true, completeSelectedTextAndQueryMetadataAuthenticated=true, ownedNativeLifetimeIndependentlyAdmitted=true and original custody/lifetime/capture/inputAssignment provenance.
steps.detail: Do not edit the original admission or extraction input. Preserve the original inputAssignmentSha256 as extraction provenance. Compute a new descriptor of this fresh approved admission. Record the promotion separately, binding original and approved bundle inventories plus original/new assignment and admission hashes.

steps.action: Issue a fresh separately approved audit-phase wrapper assignment.

fieldsToBind.captureResult: descriptor of actual passing closed capture result
fieldsToBind.nativeAuditAssignment: absolute descriptor of copied approved bundle/root-assignment.json with new bytes/SHA-256
fieldsToBind.nativeBundle: same copied bundle path as approved admission

steps.detail: Retain actual root-approved source/build/test/review/browser/runtime/protected identities and wrapper hash. Refresh exclusive-slot validity if needed while maintaining the browser binding token relationship. Hash the entire fresh wrapper assignment; root supplies that separate hash as OVF_FEATURE63_WRAPPER_ASSIGNMENT_SHA256.

steps.action: Only after those concrete root approvals, root may run the existing one-shot audit path.
steps.detail: Wrapper forwards the new native assignment digest as --assignment-sha256. Preserve both original extraction and promoted copy plus approval packet and complete audit output. A native auditor pass still has no feature qualification claim until root disposition.

equalityChain: sha256(fresh audit wrapper assignment bytes) == separately supplied OVF_FEATURE63_WRAPPER_ASSIGNMENT_SHA256

concreteWrapperGates.gate: External wrapper assignment digest must match complete assignment bytes.
Audit phase, exact owned checkout and r2 prefix; correct owned cwd.
Owned HEAD remains capture pin1257 and tracked source clean.
Exclusive slot approved, holder/root/ai_modes, token>=16 chars and validUntil strictly more than510seconds ahead; browser binding token must match.
All actual source, build, test, wrapper review, browser dependency and protected process/socket bindings still authenticate.
No listeners on5373 or5374 before audit.
Passing closed capture result at same source pin.
Fresh approved extraction admission with matching source/match/auditor and independently admitted lifetime.
New native assignment descriptor hash equals approved admission rootAssignmentSha256.
Canonical copied bundle path outside protected root and equal admitted path; full inventory authenticates.
R2 PREFIX/native-audit must not exist; creation prohibits second invocation.
